fusions.name: Spine Draw
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Drives a venomous spine in for 16 damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Bitter Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bitter darts at once, each dealing 8 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target struck spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Clean Current
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and every ally in your party. Its effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Spent Venom
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Its effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Once every 6 seconds.
